claim.claim-text: a coating layer (220; 320) including a coating mixture, the coating layer (220; 320) having a first side and a second side, the coating mixture comprising a polyolefin resin and a thermoplastic vulcanizate (TPV), wherein the TPV comprises a cured rubber dispersed in a thermoplastic resin; and a textile layer (210; 310) including a first textile, the texture layer having a first side and a second side opposing the first side; wherein, in the composite textile (200; 300), the second side of the coating layer (220; 320) and the first side of the textile layer (210; 310) are directly or indirectly bonded to each other, and wherein the coating layer (220; 320) of the composite textile (200; 300) has a level of elongation that is at least 80 percent of the level of elongation of the textile layer without the coating layer present.

2. The composite textile (200; 300) of claim 1, wherein the coating layer (220; 320) of the composite textile (200; 300) has a level of elongation that is 90 to 100 percent of the level of elongation of the textile layer (210; 310) without the coating layer (220; 320) present.

3. The composite textile (200; 300) of claim 1 or claim 2, wherein the coating mixture comprises 80 weight percent to 50 weight percent of the polyolefin resin, and 5 weight percent to 45 weight percent of the TPV.
4. The composite textile (200; 300) of any preceding claim, wherein the textile is a woven or knit textile or a non-woven textile.
5. The composite textile (200; 300) of any preceding claim, wherein the polyolefin resin of the coating mixture includes an alpha-olefin polymer or alpha-olefin copolymer.

6. The composite textile (200; 300) of any preceding claim, wherein the polyolefin resin includes crystalline regions dispersed in an amorphous matrix and wherein the polyolefin resin is optionally miscible with polypropylene.

7. The composite textile (200; 300) of any preceding claim, wherein the thermoplastic resin of the TPV includes a thermoplastic polyolefin resin, and/or wherein the cured rubber of the TPV includes a crosslinked polyolefin elastomer.

8. The composite textile (200; 300) of any preceding claim, wherein the thickness of the coating layer (220; 320) is 100-400 microns, or 300-400 microns and/or wherein a thickness of the composite textile (200; 300) is 0.8 millimeters to 2.5 millimeters.

9. The composite textile (200; 300) of preceding claim, wherein the coating layer (220; 320) has an elongation of at least 40 percent to 100 percent in a first direction and in a second direction transverse to the first direction.

10. The composite textile (200; 300) of any preceding claim, wherein the composite textile (200; 300) includes a hot melt adhesive layer having a first side and a second side opposing the first side, wherein the second side of the coating layer (220; 320) is bonded directly to the first side of the hot melt adhesive layer, and the second side of the hot melt adhesive layer is bonded directly to the first side of the textile layer (210; 310).
11. The composite textile (200; 300) of any preceding claim, wherein the first side of the coating layer (220; 320) is an outer layer of the composite textile (200; 300).
12. An article of apparel, sporting equipment, or footwear (110) comprising a composite textile (200; 300) according to any one of claims 1 to 11.
13. A method of manufacturing a composite textile (200; 300), the method comprising:

14. The method of claim 13, wherein either (a) the first coating layer (220; 320) includes a film and the step of bonding the coating layer (220; 320) to the textile layer (210; 310) comprises disposing the film on the textile layer (210; 310) and applying heat and pressure to the combination of the film and the textile layer (210; 310); or (b) the coating layer (220; 320) is formed by applying a liquid coating composition to the textile layer (210; 310) and solidifying the liquid coating composition, thereby forming the coating layer (220; 320).
15. The method of claim 13 or claim 14 wherein the composite textile (200; 300) is as further defined in any of claims 2 to 11.
